title: Threshold resonance multiplicity
question: For a fourth-order radial operator with a compactly supported potential, classify the geometric multiplicity of zero-energy threshold resonances.
first_test: Construct a nontrivial multiplicity example or prove a radial upper bound.

title: Embedded eigenvalues in fourth-order media
question: Determine which decaying real potentials permit eigenvalues embedded in the nonnegative continuous spectrum of a shifted bi-Laplacian.
first_test: Prove an absence criterion and construct a complementary example.

title: Sharp resolvent bounds near band minima
question: For a dispersion with a nonzero-frequency minimizing shell, determine the optimal weighted resolvent growth approaching the spectral edge.
first_test: Derive leading singular order and a limiting absorption estimate.

title: Spectral stability of perturbed periodic stripes
question: Quantify the shift of Floquet eigenvalues when the coefficients of a stable periodic fourth-order operator are perturbed.
first_test: Prove a uniform spectral-bound perturbation theorem under gap assumptions.

title: Nonlinear Fermi golden rule at a band edge
question: Find explicit conditions under which a discrete internal mode irreversibly couples to radiation at a degenerate fourth-order threshold.
first_test: Calculate a nonzero coupling integral and justify the induced amplitude law.

title: Localization near quasi-periodic coefficients
question: Determine whether small quasiperiodic modulations of a fourth-order operator yield localized modes or extended states.
first_test: Prove a localization or reducibility result for a fixed analytic modulation.

title: Spectral flow under curvature coupling
question: Track isolated eigenvalues of a fourth-order wave operator as a smooth curvature-induced potential is increased.
first_test: Prove monotonicity or establish a spectral crossing counterexample.

title: Band-gap solitons for finite-amplitude lattices
question: Determine whether a localized nonlinear mode can bifurcate from a finite-wavelength gap edge of a periodic fourth-order operator.
first_test: Prove a gap-soliton branch with a controlled envelope approximation.

title: Energy transfer across sparse Fourier shells
question: For cubic–quintic evolution on a torus, bound leakage from one sparse shell family into a disjoint shell family over a finite time.
first_test: Prove a quantitative leakage rate or construct fast transfer.

title: Inverse resonance reconstruction
question: Determine when a finite collection of threshold resonances identifies the coefficients of a restricted fourth-order potential family.
first_test: Construct a stable reconstruction or exhibit nonunique potentials.

title: Spectral measures of localized wave defects
question: Characterize how a compactly supported nonlinear equilibrium defect modifies the absolutely continuous spectral measure.
first_test: Prove a scattering phase formula or identify a singular component.

title: Pseudospectral growth in nonnormal wave linearizations
question: For a dissipative fourth-order linearization, determine whether large transient amplification can occur despite negative spectral bound.
first_test: Establish a resolvent-to-semigroup bound or construct an explicit amplifying example.

title: High-frequency resolvent smoothing
question: Determine the optimal derivative gain for the forced fourth-order Schrödinger resolvent on a weighted Sobolev scale.
first_test: Prove a uniform estimate or show sharp failure with wavepackets.

title: Nonlinear harmonic generation thresholds
question: Find quantitative conditions ensuring emergence of a second or third harmonic from a finite-amplitude periodic wave.
first_test: Derive a resonant normal form and nonzero transfer coefficient.

title: Anisotropic shell degeneracy
question: Classify the number and geometry of global dispersion minima after introducing a small anisotropic fourth-order term.
first_test: Establish a bifurcation diagram for isolated minima versus minimizing curves.

title: Scattering by topological wave defects
question: Determine how a static vortex or winding defect changes the scattering matrix of a specified linear wave operator.
first_test: Prove partial-wave scattering identities or a no-effect theorem.

title: Spectral pollution under Galerkin truncation
question: Classify when finite Fourier truncations create spurious eigenvalues near the essential spectrum of a fourth-order wave operator.
first_test: Give an exclusion criterion or exhibit a spectral pollution sequence.

title: Resonant mode counting under confinement
question: For bounded-domain fourth-order waves, derive asymptotically sharp counts of frequencies supporting weakly localized resonant modes.
first_test: Prove a Weyl-type count with a confinement correction.

title: Nonlinear persistence of embedded solitary modes
question: Determine whether a small nonlinear interaction preserves a solitary mode whose linear frequency lies inside a continuous band.
first_test: Establish structural persistence or a generic radiation obstruction.
